# Wicker Craft

> Handwoven rattan and wicker couches, made in Johannesburg, South Africa, with nationwide door-to-door delivery. Three-seaters, two-seaters, corner lounges, daybeds and modular sets, from R6,999 to R32,999.

Wicker Craft is a Johannesburg furniture workshop that handweaves rattan and
wicker couches on powder-coated aluminium or hardwood frames. Synthetic-weave
ranges are UV-stabilised and rainproof for year-round outdoor use. Every piece
can be customised in size, weave colour and cushion fabric, and the workshop
offers repairs, re-weaving and fitted waterproof covers.

## Products and prices (ZAR, cushions included)

- Marula Loveseat — 130cm two-seater, R6,999
- Stoep Two-Seater — 150cm, R8,999
- Highveld Three-Seater — 210cm, R12,999
- Bushveld Daybed — full-length poolside/lodge daybed, R18,999
- Karoo Corner Lounge — L-shaped, seats 6, R24,999
- Lowveld Modular Set — 8 pieces, configurable, R32,999

## Key facts

- Made in: Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa
- Delivery: nationwide, door-to-door; free in Gauteng over R10,000; 5–10 working days
- Warranty: 3 years on frame and weave, 1 year on cushions
- Trade: supplies game lodges, guesthouses, restaurants; trade pricing from 6 pieces
- Contact: hello@wickercraft.co.za, +27 00 000 0000
